meta.name: code-review
meta.description: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes — Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/PRD asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照规范和需求审查代码变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在合并前系统性地审查代码变更。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes against standards and specs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need systematic code review before merging.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会从两个维度审查代码变更：一是代码是否符合仓库的编码标准，二是代码是否实现了原始需求。它会并行运行两个子代理分别审查，最后并排展示结果。
howto.when: 当你要求审查一个分支、PR、工作进度，或说“审查自X以来的变更”时触发。

say.text: 审查这个分支的代码，从 main 开始。
say.note: Claude 会对比 main 到当前分支的差异。

say.text: 帮我审查 PR #42 的代码规范。
say.note: Claude 会检查代码是否符合仓库标准。

say.text: 审查自 HEAD~3 以来的变更是否符合需求。
say.note: Claude 会对比最近3次提交的差异。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reviews code changes along two axes: whether the code follows the repo's coding standards, and whether it matches the original requirements. It runs two parallel sub-agents and reports findings side by side.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to review a branch, PR, work-in-progress changes, or say "review since X".

say_en.text: Review this branch's code from main.
say_en.note: Claude will diff main to current branch.
Claude checks code against repo standards.

say_en.text: Review changes since HEAD~3 against spec.
